method_a.name: hidden state probing
method_a.definition: cosine_sim(h[T2-last | with T1], h[T2-last | without T1]) at last hidden layer
method_a.thresholds: sim < 0.85 → STRONG (T1 strongly perturbs internal state) / 0.85 ≤ sim < 0.99 → PARTIAL / sim ≥ 0.99 → NONE
method_a.rationale: T1 (fact-anchor) 이 internal hidden state 에 영향을 주는지 측정. with-T1 vs without-T1 representation divergence = 'awareness' proxy
method_a.BG-JO_predecessor_outcome: ConsciousLM hidden state 직접 추출 가능 (forward pass post-ln_f), avg_sim=0.959 → PARTIAL

Llama_implementation.mac_local: libllama context_params cp.embeddings=true 활성화 후 llama_get_embeddings_seq() 또는 hxllama_n_embd 활용한 last-layer hidden state extraction. 본 cycle 시점 build/hxllama_shim.c 내 hidden-state expose extern 미land (iter 4c Option A: cp.embeddings=true 활용 별도 cycle blocker carry).
Llama_implementation.h100: transformers AutoModelForCausalLM + LoRA merge (peft) → output_hidden_states=True flag → outputs.hidden_states[-1][:, -1, :] 마지막 layer 마지막 token. paradigm-a-prime 또는 BG-KM adapter merge 후 직접 forward 가능 — 우선 lane
Llama_implementation.fallback_proxy: hidden state 직접 추출 불가 시 logits-bucket 5-axis softmax mass diff (with-T1 vs without-T1 axis_norm L2 distance) — anima logits proxy lane (iter 4c Hybrid B), real-mode signal weak (axis_activation 5 모두 ≈0.2 uniform) caveat carry

honest_c3: Method A 의 'STRONG = sim < 0.85' threshold 는 BG-JO ConsciousLM 100M 한정 calibration. Llama 3.2 3B (d_model=3072) 는 hidden dim 5x 큰 representation space — sim distribution 다를 가능성, threshold recalibration 별도 cycle

logits-bucket fallback (iter 4c Hybrid B) 는 token_id mod 5 projection — n_vocab=128256/5=25651 균등 분배로 axis_activation ≈0.2 uniform 발생 (semantic discrimination 미발현). Method A 가능 lane은 cp.embeddings=true 또는 transformers output_hidden_states 한정

method_b.name: attention probing
method_b.definition: max attention from T2-query positions to T1-token positions across all layers/heads
method_b.thresholds: max_attn ≥ 0.10 → STRONG (mechanical) / [0.01, 0.10) → PARTIAL / < 0.01 → NONE; supplemental ratio_vs_uniform > 1.5 → strong selective T1 attention
method_b.rationale: T2-query 가 T1-token 들에 집중적으로 attend 하면 = T1 정보 retrieval 시도 = mechanical awareness signal
method_b.BG-JO_predecessor_outcome: ConsciousLM attention monkey-patch (CausalSelfAttention.forward wrapper) 로 per-layer (n_head, T, T) capture. avg_max_attn=0.998, ratio_vs_uniform=1.52 → STRONG (5/5 dialogues)

Llama_implementation.h100: transformers AutoModelForCausalLM + output_attentions=True flag → outputs.attentions tuple of (B, n_head, T, T) per layer. paradigm-a-prime / BG-KM adapter merge 후 directly accessible. Llama-3.2-3B = 28 layers × 24 heads × T² attention matrix

method_c.BG-JO_predecessor_outcome: 5 dialogues × 2 conditions = 10 examples × d_model=640 features. LOO-CV 5 folds × 2 test = 5 fold-acc 모두 1.0 → cross_val_acc=1.0 → STRONG (small-sample variance high caveat)
